# German Rauhut

> Freelance Technical Product Owner aus Stuttgart. 10 Jahre Mercedes-Benz-Ökosystem, Mandate in Anforderung, Test und Release. Ab sofort buchbar. Bilingual personal site (DE primary, EN at /en).

## About

German Rauhut is a Freelance Technical Product Owner based in Stuttgart, Germany. Ten years in the Mercedes-Benz ecosystem (Senior Business Analyst, then Agile Coach, Plant Relationship Manager, Change Management Team and Technical Product Owner): requirements, test and release in programmes that have to run 24/7. Freelance since 10/2025, building own AI products through Neckarshore AI — which is why he can judge where AI carries in an enterprise process and where it does not.

Diplom-Betriebswirt, Business Information Systems, DHBW Stuttgart (formerly BA Stuttgart, Fachrichtung Datenverarbeitung). 23 years of career before Mercedes-Benz across Germany, Switzerland, and Thailand — software development, consulting, operational leadership.

## Offers

- **Technical Product Ownership** (lead offer) — mandates in enterprise programmes: requirements, backlog, distributed teams, delivery. Automotive, master data, programmes that have to go live.
- **Test, release, acceptance** — test strategy, automation, release cadence.
- **AI potential analysis** — a workshop day assessing where AI agents carry in real processes, via Neckarshore AI (https://neckarshore.ai/ki-beratung).

## Current Mandate

Available immediately. Freelance Technical Product Owner for enterprise programmes — requirements, backlog, test, release, acceptance. Remote across the DACH region, on site in and around Stuttgart. Domains: automotive, master data, programmes that have to go live and stay live.

## Evidence

Own AI products, built through Neckarshore AI — this is what backs the AI-delivery claim, not a catalogue:

- **Multi-agent AI development process** — 23 specialized AI agents (architecture, implementation, security, refactoring, marketing) with structured handoff protocol, parallel execution, automated quality assurance.
- **OMNOPSIS Documentor** — AI-powered documentation engine; 905 tests, 96 API endpoints, RBAC, monitoring stack.
- Alongside: MMPs, native iOS apps and a fleet of Claude skills, all with test automation. Overview at https://neckarshore.ai/products

## Stack

- Runtime: TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, Neon, Redis/BullMQ, Python
- UI: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- Auth: Zitadel, NextAuth
- Delivery: Vercel, GitHub Actions, Docker
- Quality: Vitest, Playwright, XCTest, Swift Testing
- iOS: Swift, Xcode, App Store
- Agents: Anthropic / Claude Code (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable), xAI / Grok, OpenAI / Codex
- Integrations: Jira, Confluence, Git, Apify, Slack, ElevenLabs, Groq, Stripe, Resend

## Career Highlights

- 07/2015 – 10/2025: Mercedes-Benz AG & ecosystem — Senior Business Analyst → Agile Coach → Plant Relationship Manager → Change Management Team → Technical Product Owner. International, agile projects.
- 07/2014 – 06/2015: Senior PM Compliance at Targens, Stuttgart (AML application).
- 10/2011 – 06/2014: Business IT Consultant at Contargo AG, Basel (freight forwarding software 4ward).
- 06/2010 – 07/2013: Subproject Lead at Allianz AMOS (AML implementation).
- 04/2007 – 03/2010: Business IT Consultant at Regional Container Lines, Bangkok (ERP implementation).
- 07/1996 – 06/2000: Manager Software Development at SoftControl, Bangkok — founded and led the dev unit.
- 1992: Mandatory Military Service, German Air Force (Programmierzentrum der Luftwaffe für fliegende Waffensysteme, Welfen-Kaserne Landsberg).

Worked for: Mercedes-Benz, IBM, Deutsche Bank, Allianz, Gothaer, Contargo, Rhenus AG, Regional Container Lines, plenum, Targens, TestGilde.
